== Biography ==

Jinjur is a dairy-maid encountered along the road, recognized by Ozma despite her humble occupation and greeting her with a curtsy as "your Highness." She had previously assembled an army of women, driven the Scarecrow from the throne of the Emerald City, and fought a battle against the powerful army of Glinda the Sorceress. By the time of this encounter, she has married a man who owns nine cows and describes herself as happy, contented, and willing to lead a quiet life, minding her own business.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Glinda the Good]]''' — enemy. Jinjur once fought a battle against Glinda's army, which could indicate a lasting rivalry between them.

'''[[Ozma]]''' — acquaintance. Ozma recognizes Jinjur on sight as a dairy-maid, suggesting the two are already familiar with one another.

'''[[Scarecrow]]''' — enemy. Jinjur once drove the Scarecrow from the throne of the Emerald City, suggesting an adversarial history between them.
